title: Frontend verification stack: research the best browser tooling for agents and serve the winners as standards
body:
Source: operator 2026-11-16 (verbatim): "w tematyce działan frontendowych też chciałbym abyśmy realnie mieli wszystko najlepsze, np ta opensource browser od cloudflare + agent browser itp itd? chcemy absolutnie najlepszy setup w każdym aspekcie aplikować do naszych standardów w krn, krn ma serwować tylko najlepsze i przełomowe wnioski, po to chcemy brain i po to wszystko inne".
Outcome: one research report (krn-research, sources cited) that enumerates the current best agent-driven frontend verification stack: the open-source browser Cloudflare released (identify it exactly; do not guess), agent-browser (current global skill), Playwright/axe, visual-lab, boilerplate-2026 check:browser; for each, measured fit against our flows (render check, a11y, visual diff, perf/LCP) and a verdict adopt/trial/reject. Every adopt verdict becomes a stack-tagged standards record (frontend/wordpress) served by krn standards query, with a run check, and a task for its install path in boilerplate-2026.
Proof: krn standards query "verify a frontend change in the browser" --stack frontend returns the adopted records; the report lists rejected options with the reason.
Files: .krn/runs/research/frontend-stack/report.md, standards/records.json
